description: This file defines the RouteGroup class in the Slim Framework, responsible for grouping routes with common patterns and middleware. It implements methods to collect routes, add middleware, and retrieve the route pattern.

classes.name: RouteGroup
classes.description: Implements the RouteGroupInterface; manages route grouping, middleware addition, and pattern retrieval within the Slim Framework.

methods.name: collectRoutes
methods.description: Resolves the route callable and executes it with the route collector proxy.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds middleware (callable, string, or MiddlewareInterface) to the route group.

methods.name: addMiddleware
methods.description: Adds a MiddlewareInterface implementation to the route group middleware stack.

methods.name: appendMiddlewareToDispatcher
methods.description: Adds all middleware in the group to the given MiddlewareDispatcher.

methods.name: getPattern
methods.description: Returns the route pattern string for the group.
